jobs.job_title: Full Stack Engineer – Node.js, React.js, TypeScript & NoSQL
jobs.description:
Job Summary

Synechron is seeking a Senior Full Stack Engineer with strong expertise in ReactJS, NodeJS, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and NoSQL databases. The role will focus on building and maintaining high-performance enterprise web applications across both front-end and backend layers.

The successful candidate will develop responsive user interfaces, scalable backend services, REST APIs, and efficient data solutions. The role will contribute to application performance, build and deployment automation, debugging, monitoring, testing, production support, and Agile delivery practices.

Required

Software Requirements

ReactJS: 5+ years of experience developing responsive web applications and reusable UI components. NodeJS: 5+ years of experience developing backend services and REST APIs. JavaScript and TypeScript: 5+ years of hands-on development experience. HTML and CSS: 5+ years of experience creating responsive and accessible web interfaces. NoSQL databases: 5+ years of experience with data storage, retrieval, and efficient data management. React concepts: Strong understanding of component architecture, state management, reusability, and maintainable UI design. Data Structures: Knowledge of data structures and their practical application in software development. Performance engineering: Hands-on experience with performance tuning, bottleneck identification, debugging, monitoring, and optimization. Build automation and CI/CD: Experience automating build, test, and deployment processes. Testing and code quality: Experience participating in code reviews, application testing, defect resolution, and production support. Agile delivery: Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams in an iterative software development environment. 

Preferred

Experience supporting Banking or Retail domain applications. Exposure to Agile/Scrum methodologies. Experience with application monitoring and performance analysis tools. Experience designing reusable full-stack components and shared development utilities. Experience optimizing application resource usage to support efficient and sustainable processing. 

Overall Responsibilities

Develop scalable and responsive enterprise web applications using ReactJS and NodeJS. Build reusable, testable, maintainable, and high-performance UI components using React and TypeScript. Design, develop, integrate, and maintain REST APIs and backend services. Apply JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS to deliver functional and responsive application features. Work with NoSQL databases and implement efficient data storage, retrieval, and management practices. Optimize application performance by identifying bottlenecks, analyzing system behavior, and implementing improvements. Debug application issues across front-end, backend, integration, and data layers. Monitor application performance and support timely investigation and resolution of production issues. Architect and automate build, testing, and deployment processes. Contribute to CI/CD implementation and improvements to delivery reliability. Participate in code reviews and promote consistent coding, testing, and documentation practices. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product, quality assurance, engineering, and business stakeholders. Support production activities, incident resolution, root-cause analysis, and post-release validation. Deliver solutions that meet defined requirements for performance, quality, maintainability, reliability, and security. Use application and infrastructure resources efficiently by considering performance, scalability, and sustainability during solution design. 

Technical Skills (By Category)

Programming Languages

Essential

JavaScript with 5+ years of professional experience. TypeScript with 5+ years of professional experience. HTML with 5+ years of professional experience. CSS with 5+ years of professional experience. Strong knowledge of data structures. Ability to apply modern web development practices across front-end and backend solutions. 

Preferred

Experience developing reusable TypeScript utilities, shared components, or application libraries. Experience applying language features and coding practices that improve performance, maintainability, and testability. 

Databases/Data Management

Essential

5+ years of experience with NoSQL databases. Understanding of data modeling, data access, storage, retrieval, and performance considerations in NoSQL environments. Ability to design efficient data management solutions for high-performance web applications. Experience troubleshooting data-related application issues. 

Preferred

Experience optimizing NoSQL queries, indexes, and data access patterns. Experience supporting data migration, scaling, or availability improvements. Experience applying data-retention and resource-efficiency practices. 

Cloud Technologies

Essential

Ability to support application build, deployment, monitoring, and production operations in the project’s designated environment. Understanding of infrastructure and deployment considerations for full-stack applications. 

Preferred

Experience deploying and supporting ReactJS and NodeJS applications in cloud environments. Familiarity with cloud-based monitoring, scalability, availability, and resource optimization. Experience supporting cloud-based CI/CD and application modernization initiatives. 

Frameworks and Libraries

Essential

ReactJS. NodeJS. React component architecture and state management. Libraries and frameworks required for REST API development and backend service implementation. Tools and libraries supporting application testing and performance optimization. 

Preferred

Experience with reusable front-end component libraries. Experience with libraries supporting API integration, application monitoring, automated testing, and performance analysis. Experience evaluating frameworks and libraries for maintainability and application efficiency. 

Development Tools and Methodologies

Essential

Build automation. CI/CD processes. Code reviews. Application testing. Debugging and troubleshooting. Application monitoring. Performance tuning and optimization. Modern web development practices. Agile collaboration and iterative delivery. Production support and issue resolution. 

Preferred

Agile/Scrum methodologies. Experience implementing automated quality checks and deployment validation. Experience improving development workflows, release processes, and engineering standards. Experience with tools supporting source control, build management, testing, monitoring, and deployment. 

Security Protocols

Essential

Apply secure development practices across ReactJS, NodeJS, REST APIs, and NoSQL database integrations. Protect application data, credentials, access permissions, and service integrations. Consider input validation, secure API design, access control, error handling, and data protection during development. Address security issues identified through testing, code reviews, monitoring, or production support. 

Preferred

Experience integrating security checks into CI/CD processes. Experience securing enterprise web applications and NoSQL data services. Familiarity with security testing and remediation practices. 

Experience Requirements

Required: 5+ years of experience in ReactJS, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. Required: 5+ years of experience in NodeJS and NoSQL databases. Demonstrated experience developing scalable and responsive enterprise web applications. Experience building REST APIs, backend services, reusable UI components, and data-management solutions. Experience with performance tuning, debugging, monitoring, optimization, build automation, and CI/CD processes. Experience participating in code reviews, testing, production support, and cross-functional Agile delivery. Preferred: Experience in Banking or Retail domain applications. Preferred: Exposure to Agile/Scrum methodologies. Candidates may also qualify through an equivalent combination of relevant professional experience, technical training, demonstrable full-stack development skills, and successful delivery of comparable web applications. 

Day-to-Day Activities

Develop, test, review, and maintain ReactJS interfaces, TypeScript components, NodeJS services, REST APIs, and NoSQL data integrations. Collaborate with cross-functional teams through planning sessions, stand-ups, refinement meetings, code reviews, testing discussions, and production support activities. Deliver application features, reusable components, automated build and deployment changes, performance improvements, defect fixes, monitoring updates, and technical documentation. Investigate technical issues, identify root causes, make implementation decisions within established standards, and escalate risks affecting quality, performance, security, or delivery timelines. 

Qualifications

A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field is preferred; equivalent relevant education and professional experience may be considered. 5+ years of professional experience with ReactJS, NodeJS, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and NoSQL databases. Demonstrated experience with REST APIs, performance tuning, debugging, monitoring, build automation, CI/CD, testing, and production support. Relevant certifications in web development, JavaScript/TypeScript, cloud technologies, DevOps, or Agile delivery are preferred but not mandatory. Maintain continuous professional development in full-stack engineering, ReactJS, NodeJS, TypeScript, NoSQL technologies, performance optimization, CI/CD, security, and modern web development practices. 

Professional Competencies

Apply structured critical thinking and problem-solving to diagnose application, performance, integration, and data-related issues. Collaborate effectively with engineering, product, quality assurance, and business teams to deliver integrated solutions. Communicate technical concepts, implementation decisions, risks, and resolutions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Adapt to changing requirements, technologies, delivery priorities, and application environments while maintaining quality. Identify opportunities to improve application architecture, component reuse, automation, monitoring, performance, and sustainable resource utilization. Manage development tasks, testing, defect resolution, production support, dependencies, and delivery commitments effectively. 

S YNECHRON’S DIVERSITY & INCLUSION STATEMENT

Diversity & Inclusion are fundamental to our culture, and Synechron is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) initiative ‘Same Difference’ is committed to fostering an inclusive culture – promoting equality, diversity and an environment that is respectful to all. We strongly believe that a diverse workforce helps build stronger, successful businesses as a global company. We encourage applicants from across diverse backgrounds, race, ethnicities, religion, age, marital status, gender, sexual orientations, or disabilities to apply. We empower our global workforce by offering flexible workplace arrangements, mentoring, internal mobility, learning and development programs, and more.

All employment decisions at Synechron are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to the applicant’s gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Company Description
Codentix Tech LLP is a growing technology company focused on helping businesses strengthen their digital presence through professional websites, mobile applications, and data-driven digital marketing solutions. The company works with startups, small businesses, and enterprises to turn ideas into practical, high-impact products.


Codentix
Tech LLP believes technology should simplify operations, enhance customer experience, and support sustainable growth. The team is committed to delivering reliable, innovative, and user-centered solutions that help organizations succeed in today’s digital landscape.
Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Web Developer Internship (non-paid) based in Bengaluru. The intern will assist in developing and maintaining web applications, working on both front-end interfaces and back-end functionality under the guidance of senior developers.


Daily responsibilities may include writing clean and efficient code, implementing responsive web designs, debugging issues, and participating in code reviews. The intern will collaborate with designers, developers, and other team members to support ongoing projects and learn best practices in modern web development. The role offers hands-on experience with real client projects and an opportunity to build a strong technical foundation.


Qualifications

Front-End Development and Web Design skills, including familiarity with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for building responsive user interfaces.
Back-End Web Development and Programming skills, with exposure to at least one server-side language or framework (such as Node.js, Python, PHP, or similar).
General Web Development knowledge, covering the basics of web architecture, version control (e.g., Git), and integration of front-end and back-end components.
Strong problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and willingness to learn new tools and technologies.
Pursuing or having completed a degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred.
Ability to work on-site in Bengaluru, collaborate within a team, and communicate clearly in written and spoken English.

If interested send cv on recruitment@codentixtech.com duration - 3 months stipend- ZERO

jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Full Stack Engineer with a strong backend engineering focus to design, build, and operate large-scale distributed systems.

The ideal candidate will have deep hands-on expertise in Node.js, TypeScript, Express.js, Microservices, Kafka, MongoDB, Redis, Cloud, Docker, and Kubernetes, with robust experience building and operating high-scale backend platforms in production environments.

The role also requires hands-on frontend development experience, particularly with ReactJS, with Angular experience being relevant for full-stack delivery. As a Technical Lead, you will provide technical direction to a cross-functional engineering team while remaining hands-on with architecture, development, code quality, performance, and delivery.

You will work closely with Product Owners, Architects, DevOps teams, and other engineering teams to deliver secure, scalable, reliable, and maintainable platforms supporting digital products and everyday banking capabilities.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the design, development, and operation of large-scale, cloud-native backend platforms.
- Design and develop scalable backend services using Node.js, TypeScript, and Express.js.
- Architect and implement microservices-based distributed systems.
- Design and implement event-driven architectures using Kafka for asynchronous processing and service-to-service integration.
- Design scalable data models and optimize MongoDB databases, including indexing, aggregation pipelines, and performance tuning.
- Implement Redis for caching, distributed locking, session management, and performance optimization.
- Develop and maintain frontend applications using ReactJS while maintaining a strong backend engineering focus.
- Work with Angular where required as part of full-stack application development.
- Design and develop secure, scalable, and well-documented APIs.
- Implement appropriate authentication and authorization mechanisms and follow secure API design practices.
- Build highly available and resilient systems capable of supporting mission-critical production workloads.
- Drive application performance optimization, scalability, reliability, and observability.
- Design and operate cloud-native solutions across Azure, AWS, or GCP, with Azure preferred.
- Containerize applications using Docker and orchestrate workloads using Kubernetes.
- Implement and improve CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, and DevOps practices.
- Participate in architecture and technical design discussions and drive appropriate technical decisions.
- Establish and enforce engineering standards, coding practices, and code quality across the squad.
- Conduct code reviews and ensure maintainable, secure, and production-ready code.
- Troubleshoot complex production issues and drive root-cause analysis and resolution.
- Plan technical delivery, estimate work, manage dependencies, and support successful sprint execution.
- Mentor and guide engineers on architecture, development practices, debugging, performance optimization, and engineering standards.
- Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, DevOps, QA, and other engineering teams to ensure successful delivery.
- Contribute to technical roadmaps, platform improvements, and continuous engineering optimization.

Core Technical Requirements

Backend

- Robust hands-on expertise in Node.js
- Strong proficiency in TypeScript
- Strong experience with Express.js
- Extensive experience building enterprise-grade backend services
- Strong understanding of asynchronous and non-blocking programming

Architecture & Distributed Systems

- Strong experience with Microservices Architecture
- Deep understanding of distributed system design
- Experience designing scalable, highly available, and resilient systems
- Strong understanding of service integration and asynchronous processing
- Experience with event-driven architectures

Kafka

- Hands-on experience with Apache Kafka
- Experience designing event-driven systems using Kafka
- Understanding of asynchronous processing and service integration
- Experience handling high-volume distributed workloads

MongoDB

- Strong hands-on experience with MongoDB
- Data modeling
- Indexing strategies
- Aggregation pipelines
- Query optimization
- Performance tuning

Redis

- Strong experience with Redis
- Caching strategies
- Distributed locking
- Session management
- Performance optimization

- Experience building scalable and maintainable frontend applications
- Understanding of modern React architecture and application development

Full Stack Developer  

— React.js & Node.js   

Location: Bangalore  

Type: Full-time   

Experience: 3–5 Years  

CTC: Up to ₹10 LPA  

Company: Service-based Technology Company  

About the Role  

We are looking for a hands-on Full Stack Developer with strong experience in React.js and Node.js to join our engineering team in Bangalore. You will build scalable web applications, develop APIs, integrate third-party services, and deliver high-quality solutions for our clients.   

Key Responsibilities  
Build and maintain responsive web applications using React.js.  
Develop scalable backend services and REST APIs using Node.js.  
Work with databases such as MongoDB, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.  
Integrate third-party APIs and external services.  
Write clean, reusable, and maintainable code.  
Debug issues, optimize application performance, and improve reliability.  
Collaborate with UI/UX designers, developers, QA, and project teams.  
Participate in code reviews, testing, and deployment activities.  
Understand client requirements and translate them into technical solutions.  

Must-Have Skills  
3–5 years of professional software development experience.  
Strong hands-on experience with React.js.  
Strong backend development experience with Node.js.  
Good understanding of JavaScript / TypeScript.  
Experience building and consuming REST APIs.  
Valuable knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, and modern frontend development.  
Experience working with relational or NoSQL databases.  
Understanding of Git and standard software development practices.  
Valuable problem-solving and communication skills.  

Valuable to Have  
Experience with Next.js or Express.js.  
Exposure to AWS/Azure or any cloud platform.  
Experience with Docker and CI/CD.  
Understanding of authentication, authorization, and application security.  
Experience working in a client-facing or service-based environment.  
Why Join? Work on multiple real-world projects across different domains.  
Chance to work across both frontend and backend.  
Exposure to contemporary technologies and cloud platforms.  
Collaborative engineering environment.  
Opportunity to grow into a senior full-stack or technical leadership role.  

If you’re a Full Stack Developer who enjoys building products end-to-end and wants to work with React + Node.js, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Role Overview :

We are seeking a seasoned Generalist Fullstack Engineer to join our core product team in Bangalore. 




In this role, you will be responsible for architecting, building, and scaling end-to-end features that power our platforms growth. 




You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and data scientists, to translate complex business requirements into high-performance technical solutions. 




By bridging the gap between intuitive frontend interfaces and robust backend infrastructure, you will directly influence the user experience and drive significant improvements in our platforms reliability and feature velocity.

Key Responsibilities :

- Design and implement scalable web applications by leveraging a diverse technology stack to ensure seamless performance across all user touchpoints.

- Collaborate with product stakeholders to define technical roadmaps, ensuring that engineering efforts align with long-term business objectives and market demands.

- Optimize system architecture and database schemas to improve application latency and support the increasing scale of our user base.

- Mentor junior engineers through rigorous code reviews and architectural discussions to foster a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning.

- Troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues by performing deep-dive analysis into system logs and performance bottlenecks to maintain high availability.

Required Skillset :

- Demonstrated expertise in building full-stack applications using modern frameworks such as React.js for frontend development and Node.js, Python, Java, or Golang for backend services.

- Proven ability to architect modular, maintainable codebases that can evolve alongside changing business requirements.

- Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate effectively within a hybrid work environment in Bangalore.

- Deep understanding of RESTful API design, microservices architecture, and cloud-native deployment practices.

- A Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science or a related field from a premier institute, reflecting a strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, and system design.

- Exceptional problem-solving capabilities and the adaptability to switch between different programming languages and paradigms as project needs dictate.
